verdict.rationale: The service's own pages document the full company-formation flow online. Founders authenticate with Cartão de Cidadão, Chave Móvel Digital or eIDAS, and the platform auto-generates the articles of association (pacto social) from the form, with all partners signing digitally inside it. Fees are paid online via MBWay, Multibanco or card, and on successful registration founders receive by email the access codes to the company card and permanent certificate. The eportugal.gov.pt entry URL returning 404 is a broken link only; the live guidance on justica.gov.pt does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end online incorporation, and a working published eportugal entry path.
